what: Habitual buyer of jewelry on Etsy reports account permanently suspended without warning despite being an active buyer; buyer has over 30 outstanding orders that can no longer be tracked after suspension.
verbatim_snippet: "Lately, in the past couple of months, I have been buying a lot of inexpensive copper wire wrapped jewelry, as well as sterling silver. I have never had a problem with this site until yesterday when I tried to log on and was informed my account has been 'permanently suspended.' My reaction is WTF as I still have over 30 outstanding orders that I am no longer able to track."
notes: ConsumerAffairs page returned 403 on direct fetch; verbatim from search index. Product type: copper wire wrapped jewelry, sterling silver. Purchase pattern: frequent, inexpensive items. 30+ outstanding orders at time of suspension. Buyer tenure implied as months-long habitual buyer.
